response.label: complementary
response.rationale: The predicates 'owned_by' and 'wearing' describe different relationships between entities and items. 'owned_by' indicates possession, while 'wearing' indicates an item is being worn by an entity. These relationships represent distinct properties of an item and its associated entity. The 'owned_by' predicate focuses on ownership, whereas 'wearing' focuses on the state of an item being worn. The action contexts further support this distinction: 'master_wear_suit' explicitly describes the act of wearing an item, not the ownership of that item. The action preconditions and effects reinforce this difference. The 'wearing' predicate describes a state, while 'owned_by' describes a relationship of possession. The predicates are complementary because they describe different aspects of the same entities and items.
